433314289.title: libcap 2.75 source archive (libcap-v2.75)
433314289.summary:
Mirror of the unmodified libcap 2.75 source archive used to build Bubblewrap for Codex's Linux musl packages.
- [Upstream archive](https://mirrors.edge.kernel.org/pub/linux/libs/security/linux-privs/libcap2/libcap-2.75.tar.xz)
- SHA-256 for `libcap-2.75.tar.xz` is `de4e7e064c9ba451d5234dd46e897d7c71c96a9ebf9a0c445bc04f4742d83632`.

- Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292)
- Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293)
- Added `codex queue --resume` to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232)
